sentences.en: We were ignorant that the store was closed on Thursdays.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这家店星期四关门。

sentences.en: She is ignorant of even the simplest facts about science.
sentences.zh: 她对科学的基本事实一无所知。

sentences.en: She is ignorant of even the simplest fact about science.
sentences.zh: 她对科学的基本事实毫无所知。
